//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/interfaces/AgentInterface.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.interfaces;
import weilantianhai.agent.execute.CommandExecutor;
import weilantianhai.agent.interfaces.impl.AgentInterfaceImpl;
import weilantianhai.agent.llm.LLMClient;
import weilantianhai.agent.trace.TraceListener;
public interface AgentInterface {
    //生命周期
    void start();
    void shutdown();
    boolean isRunning();
    //提交输入
    int submitUserInput(String userInput);
    //接受回复
    void setResponseListener(ResponseListener listener);
    void clearResponseListener();
    //逐轮追踪（数据集采集 / 调试）
    void setTraceListener(TraceListener listener);
    void clearTraceListener();
    //底层模型（数据集跑不同模型对比时切换）
    /**
     * 切换底层 LLM。只影响**后续**轮次；正在执行中的请求不受影响（每轮开头读一次）。
     *
     * @param client 新的 LLM 客户端；null 会被忽略
     */
    void setClient(LLMClient client);
    /** 当前 LLM 客户端（只读）。 */
    LLMClient getClient();
    //队列管理
    int getPendingCount();
    boolean isBusy();
    int clearPending();
    boolean cancelRequest(int requestId);
    //状态查询
    String getStatusSummary();
    static AgentInterface getInstance() {
        if (InterfaceValue._INSTANCE == null) {
            throw new ExceptionInInitializerError("AgentInterface instance is not initialized");
        } else return InterfaceValue._INSTANCE;
    }
    static void initialize(
            LLMClient client,
            CommandExecutor executor
    ) {
        InterfaceValue._INSTANCE = new AgentInterfaceImpl(client, executor);
    }
}
class InterfaceValue {
    static AgentInterface _INSTANCE;
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/interfaces/AgentInterface.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/interfaces/impl/AgentInterfaceImpl.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.interfaces.impl;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import weilantianhai.agent.execute.CommandExecutor;
import weilantianhai.agent.execute.ResultFormatter;
import weilantianhai.agent.interfaces.AgentInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.interfaces.ResponseListener;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRBundle;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRCommand;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.resolver.IRParser;
import weilantianhai.agent.llm.LLMClient;
import weilantianhai.agent.llm.PromptLoader;
import weilantianhai.agent.trace.RoundTrace;
import weilantianhai.agent.trace.TraceListener;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.BlockingDeque;
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingDeque;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
public class AgentInterfaceImpl implements AgentInterface {
    /** 当前 LLM 客户端。非 final：数据集脚本可在两个任务之间切换模型做横向对比。 */
    private volatile LLMClient client;
    private final CommandExecutor executor;
    private final BlockingDeque<Request> queue = new LinkedBlockingDeque<>();
    private final AtomicInteger idGenerator = new AtomicInteger(1);
    private volatile ResponseListener listener;
    private volatile TraceListener traceListener;
    private Thread worker;
    private volatile boolean running = false;
    private volatile int currentRequestId = -1;
    private final Object queueLock =new Object();
    private final IRParser parser = new IRParser();
    private static final int MAX_ROUNDS = 30;
    public AgentInterfaceImpl(LLMClient client, CommandExecutor executor) {
        this.client = client;
        this.executor = executor;
    }
    //生命周期
    @Override
    public void start() {
        if (running) return;
        running = true;
        worker = new Thread(this::loop,"agent-worker");
        worker.setDaemon(true);
        worker.start();
    }
    @Override
    public void shutdown() {
        if(!running) return;
        running = false;
        Thread w = worker;
        if(w != null) w.interrupt();
        if (w != null) {
            try { w.join(2000); }
            catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
        }
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isRunning() {
        return running;
    }
    //提交输入
    @Override
    public int submitUserInput(String userInput) {
        if(userInput == null || userInput.isBlank()){
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("userInput can't be null or blank");
        }
        int id = idGenerator.getAndIncrement();
        queue.offer(new Request(id,userInput));
        return id;
    }
    //回调
    @Override
    public void setResponseListener(ResponseListener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
    }
    @Override
    public void clearResponseListener() {
        this.listener = null;
    }
    @Override
    public void setTraceListener(TraceListener listener) {
        this.traceListener = listener;
    }
    @Override
    public void clearTraceListener() {
        this.traceListener = null;
    }
    @Override
    public void setClient(LLMClient client) {
        if (client == null) return;
        this.client = client;
    }
    @Override
    public LLMClient getClient() {
        return this.client;
    }
    private void loop() {
        while (running) {
            Request req;
            try {
                synchronized (queueLock) {
                    req = queue.take();
                }
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                break;
            }
            process(req);
        }
    }
    private void process(Request req) {
        currentRequestId = req.id;   // ← 加这一行
        System.out.println("=== 用户输入 (id=" + req.id + ") ===\n" + req.input);
        boolean ok = false;
        try {
            List<JSONObject> messages = new ArrayList<>();
            messages.add(JSONObject.of("role","system","content",SYSTEM_PROMPT));
            messages.add(JSONObject.of("role","user","content",req.input));
            StringBuilder collected = new StringBuilder();
            String finalContent = null;
            for(int round = 1;round <= MAX_ROUNDS;round++){
                long roundStart = System.nanoTime();
                // 每轮开头快照一次 client：允许任务之间切换模型而不影响进行中的轮次
                LLMClient activeClient = client;
                String json = activeClient.chat(messages);
                RoundTrace trace = new RoundTrace(round, json);
                System.out.println("\n=== Round" + round + " LLM JSON ===\n" + json);
                // 解析失败不终止任务：降级成 Error Markdown 回传给 LLM，让它下一轮自己改。
                IRBundle bundle;
                try{
                    bundle = parser.parseAsBundle(json);
                }catch(IRException e){
                    String err = ResultFormatter.error(json, e.getCode() + ":" + e.getMessage());
                    System.out.println("\n=== Round" + round + "Parse Error ===\n" + err);
                    trace.parseFailed(e.getCode(), e.getMessage());
                    trace.setReceipts(err);
                    collected.append(err).append("\n\n");
                    messages.add(JSONObject.of("role", "assistant", "content", json));
                    messages.add(JSONObject.of("role", "user", "content", "[Tool Results]\n\n" + err));
                    trace.setElapsedMs((System.nanoTime() - roundStart) / 1_000_000L);
                    fireRound(req.id, trace);
                    continue;
                }
                // 解析成功：把类型清单与 done/content 记进 trace
                List<String> types = new ArrayList<>();
                for (IRCommand c : bundle.getOperations()) types.add(c.getType());
                trace.parseSucceeded(types, bundle.isDone(), bundle.getContent());
                if(bundle.isDone()){
                    System.out.println("=== Round" + round + "done ===");
                    finalContent = bundle.getContent();
                    trace.setElapsedMs((System.nanoTime() - roundStart) / 1_000_000L);
                    fireRound(req.id, trace);
                    ok = true;
                    break;
                }
                String md = executor.execute(bundle, json);
                System.out.println("\n=== Round" + round + "Markdown ===\n" + md);
                trace.setReceipts(md);
                // 从回执里反推 type / exec 级错误（GuardedOperation 把参数错误吞到执行期）
                TraceAnalysis.analyze(md, trace);
                collected.append(md).append("\n\n");
                messages.add(JSONObject.of("role", "assistant", "content", json));
                String toolResult = (md == null || md.isBlank())
                        ? "[Tool Results]\n\n(no output)"
                        : "[Tool Results]\n\n" + md;
                messages.add(JSONObject.of("role", "user", "content", toolResult));
                trace.setElapsedMs((System.nanoTime() - roundStart) / 1_000_000L);
                fireRound(req.id, trace);
            }
            notifyResponse(req.id, buildReply(finalContent, collected.toString().trim()));
            ok = true;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("处理失败: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
            notifyError(req.id, "处理失败: " + e.getMessage());
        } finally {
            currentRequestId = -1;
            TraceListener tl = traceListener;
            if (tl != null) {
                try { tl.onRequestFinished(req.id, ok); }
                catch (Throwable ignored) { }
            }
        }
    }
    /** 把一轮 trace 交给 listener；listener 抛异常绝不影响主流程。 */
    private void fireRound(int requestId, RoundTrace trace) {
        TraceListener tl = traceListener;
        if (tl == null) return;
        try {
            tl.onRound(requestId, trace);
        } catch (Throwable t) {
            System.err.println("traceListener.onRound 抛异常（已忽略）: " + t.getMessage());
        }
    }
    /**
     * 把模型的总结（{@code content}）或累积的执行结果拼成给用户看的一句话。
     *
     * <p>优先用模型自己写的 {@code content}——它是"给用户看的一句话总结"；
     * 没有时才退回累积的 Markdown。
     */
    private String buildReply(String content, String md) {
        if (content != null && !content.isBlank()) return content.trim();
        if (md == null || md.isBlank()) return "完成。";
        if (CommandExecutor.DONE_MARKER.equals(md)) return "完成。";
        return "操作已执行：\n" + md;
    }
    private void notifyResponse(int id, String text) {
        ResponseListener l = listener;
        if (l != null) l.onResponse(id, text);
    }
    private void notifyError(int id, String msg) {
        ResponseListener l = listener;
        if (l != null) l.onError(id, msg);
    }
    private record Request(int id, String input) {}
    private static final String SYSTEM_PROMPT = PromptLoader.loadSystemPrompt();
    //队列管理
    @Override
    public int getPendingCount() {
        return queue.size();
    }
    @Override
    public boolean isBusy() {
        return currentRequestId != -1;
    }
    @Override
    public int clearPending() {
        synchronized (queueLock) {
            int count = queue.size();
            queue.clear();
            return count;
        }
    }
    @Override
    public boolean cancelRequest(int requestId) {
        if (currentRequestId == requestId) return false;
        synchronized (queueLock) {
            return queue.removeIf(r -> r.id() == requestId);
        }
    }
//状态查询
    @Override
    public String getStatusSummary() {
        int pending = queue.size();
        if (currentRequestId != -1) {
            return pending > 0
                    ? "处理中 (id=" + currentRequestId + ")，队列 " + pending + " 条"
                    : "处理中 (id=" + currentRequestId + ")";
        }
        return pending > 0 ? "空闲，队列 " + pending + " 条" : "空闲";
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/interfaces/impl/AgentInterfaceImpl.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/interfaces/impl/TraceAnalysis.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.interfaces.impl;
import weilantianhai.agent.trace.RoundTrace;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
/**
 * 从 {@code CommandExecutor} 产出的回执 Markdown 里**反推错误级别**，填进 {@link RoundTrace}。
 *
 * <h3>为什么要反推</h3>
 *
 * <p>{@code CommandExecutor.execute} 只回一个拼好的字符串，不告诉你"这条是参数错还是执行错"。
 * 而数据集量化评估需要的恰恰是这个区分：
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>类型级</b>（typeOk）—— 参数缺失 / 枚举非法 / 向量非单位 / 非正交 / 未知操作类型。
 *       这些是「模型把 IR 写错了」，属于 prompt 与格式理解问题；</li>
 *   <li><b>执行级</b>（execOk）—— 模型不存在 / 机位不存在 / 下标越界 / UI 不可用。
 *       这些是「模型对世界状态的判断错了」，属于语义与多轮记忆问题。</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <h3>判定依据</h3>
 *
 * <p>两类错误在文本上可区分：
 * <ul>
 *   <li>整批格式错：{@code # Error} 开头（由 {@code ResultFormatter.error} 产出）；</li>
 *   <li>单条错：{@code # TYPE(id=n)\nError: 原因}（由 {@code OperationParams.errorBody} 产出）；</li>
 *   <li>类型级关键词：{@code INVALID} / {@code MISSING} / {@code 必须是} / {@code 不能为空} /
 *       {@code 非法} / {@code 未知操作类型} / {@code 超过上限} / {@code 不能同时} /
 *       {@code 单位向量} / {@code 正交};</li>
 *   <li>其余单条 Error 归为执行级。</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>这是个**启发式**判定，不追求 100% 精确；真正的仲裁是人工打分器。
 * 它的价值在自动刷量模式下给出一个可用的近似值。
 */
final class TraceAnalysis {
    /** 单条操作回执的头：{@code # TYPE(id=3)} */
    private static final Pattern RECEIPT_HEAD = Pattern.compile("^#\\s+([A-Z0-9_]+)\\(id=(\\d+)\\)\\s*$");
    /** 类型级错误关键词（命中任一 → typeErrors）。 */
    private static final String[] TYPE_HINTS = {
            "INVALID", "MISSING", "UNKNOWN_OP", "未知操作类型",
            "必须是", "不能为空", "非法", "超过上限", "不支持",
            "不能同时", "单位向量", "正交", "缺少"
    };
    private TraceAnalysis() {
    }
    /** 扫描回执 Markdown，把错误分别归到 typeErrors / execErrors。 */
    static void analyze(String receipts, RoundTrace trace) {
        if (receipts == null || receipts.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        // 整批格式错：直接判类型级（IR 本身写得不合法）
        if (receipts.startsWith("# Error")) {
            String reason = extractReason(receipts);
            trace.addTypeError(reason);
            return;
        }
        String[] lines = receipts.split("\\R");
        String currentType = null;
        boolean inErrorBlock = false;
        StringBuilder errorBuf = new StringBuilder();
        for (String raw : lines) {
            String line = raw.strip();
            Matcher m = RECEIPT_HEAD.matcher(line);
            if (m.matches()) {
                flushError(currentType, errorBuf, trace);
                currentType = m.group(1);
                inErrorBlock = false;
                errorBuf.setLength(0);
                continue;
            }
            if (line.startsWith("Error:") || line.startsWith("Error：")) {
                inErrorBlock = true;
                errorBuf.setLength(0);
                errorBuf.append(line);
                continue;
            }
            if (inErrorBlock) {
                // Error 正文可能跨行（业务错误消息里带换行）
                if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) {
                    flushError(currentType, errorBuf, trace);
                    inErrorBlock = false;
                } else {
                    errorBuf.append(' ').append(line);
                }
            }
        }
        flushError(currentType, errorBuf, trace);
    }
    private static void flushError(String type, StringBuilder buf, RoundTrace trace) {
        if (buf.length() == 0) {
            return;
        }
        String msg = buf.toString().strip();
        String tagged = (type == null ? "" : "[" + type + "] ") + msg;
        if (isTypeLevel(msg)) {
            trace.addTypeError(tagged);
        } else {
            trace.addExecError(tagged);
        }
        buf.setLength(0);
    }
    private static boolean isTypeLevel(String message) {
        String upper = message.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        for (String hint : TYPE_HINTS) {
            if (upper.contains(hint.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    /** 从 {@code # Error} 块里抠出 Reason 行。 */
    private static String extractReason(String receipts) {
        int idx = receipts.indexOf("Reason:");
        if (idx < 0) {
            return firstLine(receipts);
        }
        String tail = receipts.substring(idx + "Reason:".length()).strip();
        // 去掉包裹的 ``` 围栏
        tail = tail.replaceAll("(?s)```[a-zA-Z]*", "").strip();
        return tail.isEmpty() ? firstLine(receipts) : firstLine(tail);
    }
    private static String firstLine(String s) {
        int nl = s.indexOf('\n');
        return nl < 0 ? s.strip() : s.substring(0, nl).strip();
    }
}

package weilantianhai.agent.ir;
public class IRException extends Exception {
    private final String code;
    public IRException(String code, String message) {
        super(message);
        this.code = code;
    }
    public IRException(String code, String message, Throwable cause) {
        super(message, cause);
        this.code = code;
    }
    public String getCode(){
        return code;
    }
}

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/AddTetrahedronOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.AgentBridge;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import org.joml.Vector4f;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * ADD_TETRAHEDRON：直接指定四个顶点，往模型里追加一个四面体（文档 §6.5）。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code name}、{@code v0}~{@code v3}（每个是 {@code {pos, color?, normal?}}），
 * 可选操作级 {@code color}（一次指定四个顶点，会被顶点自己的 {@code color} 覆盖）。
 *
 * <pre>
 * # ADD_TETRAHEDRON(id=26)
 * Successfully add tetrahedron #0 to "Sculpt/Patch"
 * Tetrahedrons: 1
 * Now kind is CARVED
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>往一个空模型（{@code GROUP}）里加胞是合法的，它会变成 {@code CARVED}。
 *
 * <p><b>跨语言说明</b>：Java 无法构造渲染侧的 {@code Vertex4D}（构造函数 private、
 * 公开那个带 {@code DefaultConstructorMarker} 且是 synthetic），所以经由
 * {@link AgentBridge#addTetrahedron} 转发，位置/颜色/法向都用扁平数组传递。
 *
 * <p><b>法向量缺省</b>：四个顶点的法向都留空时，由渲染侧补一个由这四个点算出的
 * 超平面单位法向量（{@code hyperplaneNormal}）。
 */
public class AddTetrahedronOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    private static final String[] VERTEX_KEYS = {"v0", "v1", "v2", "v3"};
    private String name;
    private final float[] positions = new float[16];
    private final int[] colors = new int[4];
    private final float[] normals = new float[16];
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "ADD_TETRAHEDRON";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        this.name = OperationParams.getRequiredPath(data, "name", "NAME");
        int defaultArgb = OperationParams.parseArgb(
                data.get("color"), OperationParams.DEFAULT_COLOR, "color", "COLOR");
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            String key = VERTEX_KEYS[i];
            Object raw = data.get(key);
            if (raw == null) {
                throw new IRException("VERTEX_MISSING", "缺少必填字段 " + key);
            }
            if (!(raw instanceof JSONObject v)) {
                throw new IRException("VERTEX_INVALID",
                        key + " 必须是对象，形如 {\"pos\":[0,0,0,0], \"color\":\"#FFB0B0B0\"}");
            }
            Object rawPos = v.get("pos");
            if (rawPos == null) {
                throw new IRException("VERTEX_POS_MISSING", key + " 缺少 pos");
            }
            Vector4f pos = OperationParams.toVector4(rawPos, key + ".pos", "VERTEX");
            positions[i * 4] = pos.x;
            positions[i * 4 + 1] = pos.y;
            positions[i * 4 + 2] = pos.z;
            positions[i * 4 + 3] = pos.w;
            colors[i] = OperationParams.parseArgb(
                    v.get("color"), defaultArgb, key + ".color", "VERTEX");
            Vector4f n = OperationParams.getOptionalVector4(v, "normal", "VERTEX");
            if (n != null) {
                normals[i * 4] = n.x;
                normals[i * 4 + 1] = n.y;
                normals[i * 4 + 2] = n.z;
                normals[i * 4 + 3] = n.w;
            }
            // 缺失时保持 0，交给渲染侧按"全部为零"补超平面法向量
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) {
        int index = AgentBridge.addTetrahedron(name, positions, colors, normals);
        return "Successfully add tetrahedron #" + index + " to \"" + name + "\"\n"
                + "Tetrahedrons: " + ModelQuery.tetrahedronText(renderer, name) + "\n"
                + "Now kind is CARVED";
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/AddTetrahedronOperation.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/ApplyTransformToVertexOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * APPLY_TRANSFORM_TO_VERTEX：把变换矩阵烘焙进顶点，产出顶点已在世界坐标的新模型（文档 §4.1.6）。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code name}（源路径，必须存在）、{@code dest}（目标路径，必须不存在）。
 *
 * <pre>
 * # APPLY_TRANSFORM_TO_VERTEX(id=11)
 * Successfully apply transform of "Tower/Base"
 * Created "Tower/Baked", matrix is identity
 * Tetrahedrons: 48
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>语义：{@code p_new = M · p_old}；结果的 {@code kind} 为 {@code CARVED}；源模型不变。
 *
 * <p><b>注意</b>：早期实现会无条件要求 {@code dest} 不存在，导致文档描述的
 * "原地烘焙"（{@code dest == name}）必然失败；文档 §4.1.6 现在也明确要求
 * {@code dest} 不存在，所以这里按"必须换一个新路径"来处理，并在 {@code dest == name}
 * 时给出明确错误，避免它崩在渲染层。
 */
public class ApplyTransformToVertexOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    private String name;
    private String dest;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "APPLY_TRANSFORM_TO_VERTEX";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        this.name = OperationParams.getRequiredPath(data, "name", "NAME");
        this.dest = OperationParams.getRequiredPath(data, "dest", "DEST");
        if (name.equals(dest)) {
            throw new IRException("DEST_EQUALS_NAME",
                    "dest 不能等于 name（不支持原地烘焙），请换一个新路径：" + dest);
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) {
        renderer.getModel().applyTransformToVertex(name, dest);
        return "Successfully apply transform of \"" + name + "\"\n"
                + "Created \"" + dest + "\", matrix is identity\n"
                + "Tetrahedrons: " + ModelQuery.tetrahedronText(renderer, dest);
    }
}

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CameraBookmarkResolver.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import HCloudbyte.ui.interfaces.UIInterface;
import HCloudbyte.ui.viewport.CameraRecord;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
import java.util.List;
/**
 * 机位寻址工具：把 {@code name} / {@code index} 参数解析为机位列表里的**唯一下标**。
 *
 * <p>机位操作共用一套寻址规则，收敛在这里：
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code name} 优先——写起来更像人话（"跳到俯视"）；</li>
 *   <li>{@code index} 兜底——重名或名字难写时用；下标从 0 开始，与
 *       {@code LIST_CAMERA_BOOKMARKS} 的返回一致；</li>
 *   <li>两个都没给 → 报错；</li>
 *   <li>名字找不到 → 报错并**列出当前所有机位名**，方便 LLM 下一轮纠正；</li>
 *   <li>名字匹配到多个 → 报错并要求改用 {@code index}（不擅自替用户挑一个）。</li>
 * </ul>
 */
final class CameraBookmarkResolver {
    private CameraBookmarkResolver() {}
    /**
     * 解析机位参数。
     *
     * @param data      操作参数
     * @param codePrefix 错误码前缀，用操作名（如 {@code "GO_CAMERA_BOOKMARK"}）
     * @return 机位在列表中的唯一下标（&gt;= 0）
     * @throws IRException 参数缺失 / 名字不存在 / 名字重名时抛出
     */
    static int resolve(JSONObject data, String codePrefix) throws IRException {
        List<CameraRecord> records = UIInterface.getInstance().getCameraRecords();
        String name = OperationParams.getOptionalString(data, "name", null);
        Integer index = readOptionalIndex(data, codePrefix);
        if (name == null && index == null) {
            throw new IRException(codePrefix + "_MISSING",
                    "必须给出 name 或 index 之一" + availableHint(records));
        }
        // index 单独给定时，做范围校验（越界消息里带上实际数量）
        if (name == null) {
            if (index < 0 || index >= records.size()) {
                throw new IRException(codePrefix + "_INDEX_OUT_OF_RANGE",
                        "index=" + index + " 越界，当前共 " + records.size() + " 个机位");
            }
            return index;
        }
        int found = -1;
        int matches = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            String n = records.get(i).getName();
            if (name.equals(n)) {
                matches++;
                if (found < 0) found = i;
            }
        }
        if (matches == 0) {
            throw new IRException(codePrefix + "_NOT_FOUND",
                    "找不到名为 \"" + name + "\" 的机位" + availableHint(records));
        }
        if (matches > 1) {
            throw new IRException(codePrefix + "_AMBIGUOUS",
                    "机位名 \"" + name + "\" 有 " + matches + " 个，请改用 index 指定");
        }
        return found;
    }
    /** 读取可选的 index；缺失返回 null。负数直接判非法。 */
    private static Integer readOptionalIndex(JSONObject data, String codePrefix) throws IRException {
        if (data == null || data.get("index") == null) {
            return null;
        }
        int value = OperationParams.getRequiredInt(data, "index", codePrefix);
        return value;
    }
    /** "，当前机位：[0]俯视 [1]机位2" 形式提示；没有机位时给出可读文案。 */
    private static String availableHint(List<CameraRecord> records) {
        if (records.isEmpty()) {
            return "（当前没有任何机位，可先用 SAVE_CAMERA_BOOKMARK 记录一个）";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("（当前机位：");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) sb.append(' ');
            sb.append('[').append(i).append(']').append(records.get(i).getName());
        }
        return sb.append('）').toString();
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CameraBookmarkResolver.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CameraViewFormatter.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.utils.Coordinate4D;
/**
 * 摄像机坐标系（四个基向量）的统一格式化工具。
 *
 * <p>{@link GetCameraViewOperation}、{@link SetCameraViewOperation}、
 * {@link RotateCameraViewOperation} 都用它的输出，保证回给 AI 的文本完全一致：
 * <pre>
 * vx=(1, 0, 0, 0)
 * vy=(0, 1, 0, 0)
 * vz=(0, 0, 1, 0)
 * vw=(0, 0, 0, 1)
 * </pre>
 */
final class CameraViewFormatter {
    private CameraViewFormatter() {}
    /** 把四个基向量格式化为多行文本（不含前导的 Success/Current is 行） */
    static String format(Coordinate4D view) {
        return "vx=" + OperationParams.formatVector4(view.getVx()) + "\n"
                + "vy=" + OperationParams.formatVector4(view.getVy()) + "\n"
                + "vz=" + OperationParams.formatVector4(view.getVz()) + "\n"
                + "vw=" + OperationParams.formatVector4(view.getVw());
    }
}

package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * COPY_MODEL：复制一个模型节点（文档 §4.1.4）。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code src}（源路径，必须存在）、{@code dst}（新路径，必须不存在）。
 *
 * <pre>
 * # COPY_MODEL(id=9)
 * Successfully copy "Tower/Base" to "Tower/BaseCopy"
 * Tetrahedrons: 48
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>复制内容：全部四面体（四面体独立、顶点实例复用）、{@code kind}、{@code params}
 * 以及变换矩阵。
 *
 * <p><b>与文档的差异</b>：文档 §4.1.4 写的是"不递归子模型"，但当前实现
 * （{@code ModelInterfaceImpl.copyModel}）会连同**整棵子树**一起复制
 * （{@code src/... → dst/...}）；{@code src} 也可以是中间/分组路径。
 * 这里以实际实现为准，返回的四面体数是 {@code dst} 自身的数量。
 */
public class CopyModelOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    private String src;
    private String dst;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "COPY_MODEL";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        this.src = OperationParams.getRequiredPath(data, "src", "SRC");
        this.dst = OperationParams.getRequiredPath(data, "dst", "DST");
        if (src.equals(dst)) {
            throw new IRException("SRC_EQUALS_DST", "src 与 dst 不能相同：" + src);
        }
        if (dst.startsWith(src + "/")) {
            throw new IRException("DST_INSIDE_SRC",
                    "dst 不能位于 src 的子树内：" + dst + " 在 " + src + " 之下");
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) {
        renderer.getModel().copyModel(src, dst);
        return "Successfully copy \"" + src + "\" to \"" + dst + "\"\n"
                + "Tetrahedrons: " + ModelQuery.tetrahedronText(renderer, dst);
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CopyModelOperation.java========================================

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CreateBall4Operation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import org.joml.Vector4f;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * CREATE_BALL4：创建四维球的三维边界（3-球面）（文档 §5.2.7）。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code target}、{@code name}、{@code center}、{@code radius}（{@code > 0}）、
 * {@code density}（{@code > 0}）。
 *
 * <pre>
 * # CREATE_BALL4(id=20)
 * Successfully create "Tower/Top" (BALL4)
 * Center=(0, 0, 0, 2.2), radius=0.9, density=2.0
 * Tetrahedrons: 384
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>实现把超立方体的 8 个胞各细分成 {@code k×k×k} 个小立方体（cubed sphere），
 * {@code k = clamp(ceil(density), 1, 64)}，胞数 = {@code 8 · k³ · 6}。
 * 因为代价是 {@code O(k³)}，这里对 {@code density} 做了上限保护，避免 LLM 给一个
 * 夸张值直接把内存吃光。
 */
public class CreateBall4Operation extends GuardedOperation {
    /** density 上限；文档里渲染侧默认细分上限是 64（约 1260 万四面体），这里收紧到 24 防呆 */
    private static final float MAX_DENSITY = 24f;
    private ShapeTarget target;
    private Vector4f center;
    private float radius;
    private float density;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "CREATE_BALL4";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        this.target = ShapeTarget.parse(data, "CREATE_BALL4");
        this.center = OperationParams.getRequiredVector4(data, "center", "CENTER");
        this.radius = OperationParams.getRequiredPositiveFloat(data, "radius", "RADIUS");
        this.density = OperationParams.getRequiredPositiveFloat(data, "density", "DENSITY");
        if (density > MAX_DENSITY) {
            throw new IRException("DENSITY_TOO_LARGE",
                    "density 不能超过 " + OperationParams.fmt(MAX_DENSITY)
                            + "（胞数是 O(k³)，过大会耗光内存）：" + density);
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) {
        renderer.getShape().createBall4(target.target, target.name, center, radius, density);
        return "Successfully create \"" + target.path + "\" (BALL4)\n"
                + "Center=" + OperationParams.formatVector4(center)
                + ", radius=" + OperationParams.fmt(radius)
                + ", density=" + OperationParams.fmt(density) + "\n"
                + "Tetrahedrons: " + ModelQuery.tetrahedronText(renderer, target.path);
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CreateBall4Operation.java========================================

package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;

import org.joml.Vector4f;

/**

 *
 * <p>参数：{@code target}、{@code name}、{@code base}（3D 网格 DSL，见 {@link MeshBaseSpec}）、

package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.ogl3d.data.Mesh;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * CREATE_PRISM4：以 3D 网格为底面，沿 w 轴从 {@code ws} 拉伸到 {@code we}（文档 §5.2.5）。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code target}、{@code name}、{@code base}（3D 网格 DSL，见 {@link MeshBaseSpec}）、
 * {@code ws}、{@code we}。
 *
 * <pre>
 * # CREATE_PRISM4(id=18)
 * Successfully create "Tower/Body" (PRISM4)
 * Base: PRISM sides=6 radius=1 height=2 (20 triangles), transforms=[ROTATE]
 * w range=(-1.5, 1.5)
 * Tetrahedrons: 60
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>要求 {@code ws != we}；{@code ws > we} 时实现会自动交换，返回文案里给出归一化后的区间。
 */
public class CreatePrism4Operation extends GuardedOperation {
    private ShapeTarget target;
    private MeshBaseSpec base;
    private float ws;
    private float we;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "CREATE_PRISM4";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        this.target = ShapeTarget.parse(data, "CREATE_PRISM4");
        this.base = MeshBaseSpec.parse(data.get("base"), "BASE");
        this.ws = OperationParams.getRequiredFloat(data, "ws", "WS");
        this.we = OperationParams.getRequiredFloat(data, "we", "WE");
        if (ws == we) {
            throw new IRException("W_RANGE_EMPTY",
                    "Prism w range must not be empty, got ws = we = " + OperationParams.fmt(ws));
        }
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException {
        Mesh mesh = base.build();
        MeshBaseSpec.requireTriangles(mesh, "Prism");
        renderer.getShape().createPrism4(target.target, target.name, mesh, ws, we);
        float lo = Math.min(ws, we);
        float hi = Math.max(ws, we);
        return "Successfully create \"" + target.path + "\" (PRISM4)\n"
                + "Base: " + base.summary(mesh) + "\n"
                + "w range=(" + OperationParams.fmt(lo) + ", " + OperationParams.fmt(hi) + ")\n"
                + "Tetrahedrons: " + ModelQuery.tetrahedronText(renderer, target.path);
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/CreatePrism4Operation.java========================================

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/DatasetQuery.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
/**
 * 数据集查询：读取**经人工审核打分**的运行记录，供 Agent 自查历史。
 *
 * <h3>数据从哪来</h3>
 *
 * <p>由数据集脚本（{@code DatasetLauncher}）产出：每跑完一道题就落一条记录到
 * {@code data/dataset/raw/<日期>/<模型>__<类别>.jsonl}，并带有人工给出的
 * {@code verdict}（正确 / 不正确）与评语。
 *
 * <h3>为什么是"两级"接口</h3>
 *
 * <p>一次性把整个数据集塞进上下文既浪费又噪声大。所以先让 Agent 取**分类目录**
 * （{@link ListDatasetCategoriesOperation}），看清有哪些类别、各多少条、判对多少，
 * 再挑一个类别取具体记录（{@link GetDatasetRecordsOperation}）。
 *
 * <h3>有意不返回 {@code check}</h3>
 *
 * <p>记录里的 {@code check} 是**机器判定的标准答案**，{@code note} 往往直接写着
 * "陷阱题：应当拒绝"。如果把这些回给模型，正在进行的评测就可能被"看到答案"污染 ——
 * 于是这里只回**题目 + 人工结论 + 人工评语**，不回判据本身。
 * 需要时再加开关即可。
 *
 * <h3>路径</h3>
 *
 * <p>默认 {@code data/dataset}，与 {@code weilantianhai.dataset.DatasetPaths.DATASET_ROOT}
 * 保持一致；但那边是相对**工作目录**，这里额外向上找 {@code pom.xml} 锚定到**项目根**，
 * 因为 IDE 的 Run 配置常常把工作目录设成模块目录。
 * 也可用系统属性 {@code -Djfx34d.dataset.root=<绝对路径>} 覆盖。
 */
final class DatasetQuery {
    /** 覆盖数据集根目录的系统属性。 */
    static final String ROOT_PROPERTY = "jfx34d.dataset.root";
    /** 单条记录里回复正文的最大展示长度（太长会淹没上下文）。 */
    private static final int ANSWER_MAX = 240;
    private DatasetQuery() {
    }
    /* ==================== 定位与读取 ==================== */
    /** 数据集根目录（绝对路径）。 */
    static Path root() {
        String override = System.getProperty(ROOT_PROPERTY);
        if (override != null && !override.isBlank()) {
            return Path.of(override.trim());
        }
        Path rel = Path.of("data", "dataset");
        Path project = findProjectRoot();
        return project == null ? rel.toAbsolutePath().normalize() : project.resolve(rel);
    }
    /** 从工作目录向上找 {@code pom.xml}，最多 6 层。找不到返回 null。 */
    private static Path findProjectRoot() {
        Path dir = Path.of("").toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && dir != null; i++) {
            if (Files.exists(dir.resolve("pom.xml"))) {
                return dir;
            }
            dir = dir.getParent();
        }
        return null;
    }
    /** 扫 {@code raw/} 下所有 {@code .jsonl}（跳过以 {@code .} 开头的备份目录）。 */
    static List<JSONObject> loadAll() throws IRException {
        Path raw = root().resolve("raw");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(raw)) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<JSONObject> all = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Stream<Path> walk = Files.walk(raw)) {
            for (Path p : walk.filter(f -> f.toString().endsWith(".jsonl"))
                    .filter(f -> !isUnderDotDir(raw, f))
                    .sorted()
                    .toList()) {
                all.addAll(readJsonl(p));
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IRException("DATASET_IO", "读取数据集失败：" + e.getMessage());
        }
        return all;
    }
    private static boolean isUnderDotDir(Path base, Path p) {
        for (Path seg : base.relativize(p)) {
            if (seg.toString().startsWith(".")) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    private static List<JSONObject> readJsonl(Path file) {
        List<JSONObject> out = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (String line : Files.readAllLines(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                String s = line.strip();
                if (s.isEmpty() || s.startsWith("#")) {
                    continue;
                }
                try {
                    out.add(JSONObject.parseObject(s));
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    System.err.println("[dataset-query] 跳过坏行 " + file.getFileName()
                            + ": " + e.getMessage());
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.err.println("[dataset-query] 读取失败 " + file + ": " + e.getMessage());
        }
        return out;
    }
    /* ==================== 分类目录 ==================== */
    /** 一个类别的汇总。 */
    private static final class Stat {
        int total;
        int correct;
        int incorrect;
        int other;
        final TreeSet<String> models = new TreeSet<>();
    }
    /** 生成分类目录（第一级接口的返回正文）。 */
    static String catalog() throws IRException {
        Path root = root();
        List<JSONObject> all = loadAll();
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("## DATASET CATALOG\n");
        sb.append("root = ").append(root).append('\n');
        if (all.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("共 0 条记录 —— 数据集还是空的。\n");
            sb.append("（用数据集脚本跑题并人工打分后，才会在这里出现数据；\n");
            sb.append(" 也可以直接查看 ").append(root.resolve("raw")).append(" 是否存在。）\n");
            return sb.toString();
        }
        Map<String, Stat> byCategory = new TreeMap<>();
        for (JSONObject rec : all) {
            String cat = rec.getString("category");
            if (cat == null || cat.isBlank()) {
                cat = "unknown";
            }
            Stat st = byCategory.computeIfAbsent(cat, k -> new Stat());
            st.total++;
            String label = verdictLabel(rec);
            if ("correct".equals(label)) {
                st.correct++;
            } else if ("incorrect".equals(label)) {
                st.incorrect++;
            } else {
                st.other++;
            }
            String model = modelOf(rec);
            if (model != null) {
                st.models.add(model);
            }
        }
        sb.append("共 ").append(all.size()).append(" 条记录，")
          .append(byCategory.size()).append(" 个类别。\n\n");
        sb.append("| category | records | correct | incorrect | other | models |\n");
        sb.append("| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |\n");
        for (Map.Entry<String, Stat> e : byCategory.entrySet()) {
            Stat st = e.getValue();
            sb.append("| ").append(e.getKey())
              .append(" | ").append(st.total)
              .append(" | ").append(st.correct)
              .append(" | ").append(st.incorrect)
              .append(" | ").append(st.other)
              .append(" | ").append(String.join(", ", st.models))
              .append(" |\n");
        }
        sb.append("\n下一步：用 GET_DATASET_RECORDS 取某个类别里的记录，例如\n");
        sb.append("  {\"type\":\"GET_DATASET_RECORDS\",\"id\":1,\"no_result\":false,")
          .append("\"data\":{\"category\":\"").append(byCategory.keySet().iterator().next())
          .append("\",\"limit\":5}}\n");
        sb.append("可选参数：model、verdict（correct/incorrect/skip/error/timeout）、limit（默认 5，最大 50）。\n");
        sb.append("注：判定标准 check 不在返回内容里，只回题目与人工结论。\n");
        return sb.toString();
    }
    /* ==================== 某类记录 ==================== */
    /**
     * 取某类别的记录。
     *
     * @param category 类别；传 {@code all} / {@code *} 表示不按类别过滤
     * @param model    可选，按模型标识过滤（{@code deepseek} / {@code qwen}）
     * @param verdict  可选，按结论过滤（{@code correct} / {@code incorrect} / …）
     * @param limit    最多返回几条
     */
    static String records(String category, String model, String verdict, int limit) throws IRException {
        List<JSONObject> all = loadAll();
        String catFilter = (category == null || category.isBlank()
                || "all".equalsIgnoreCase(category) || "*".equals(category))
                ? null : category.strip();
        String modelFilter = model == null || model.isBlank() ? null : model.strip();
        String verdictFilter = verdict == null || verdict.isBlank()
                ? null : verdict.strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<JSONObject> hit = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JSONObject rec : all) {
            if (catFilter != null && !catFilter.equalsIgnoreCase(rec.getString("category"))) {
                continue;
            }
            if (modelFilter != null && !modelFilter.equalsIgnoreCase(modelOf(rec))) {
                continue;
            }
            if (verdictFilter != null && !verdictFilter.equals(verdictLabel(rec))) {
                continue;
            }
            hit.add(rec);
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append("## DATASET RECORDS\n");
        sb.append("筛选：category=").append(catFilter == null ? "(不限)" : catFilter)
          .append("  model=").append(modelFilter == null ? "(不限)" : modelFilter)
          .append("  verdict=").append(verdictFilter == null ? "(不限)" : verdictFilter)
          .append('\n');
        if (hit.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("没有匹配的记录。\n");
            TreeSet<String> cats = new TreeSet<>();
            for (JSONObject rec : all) {
                String c = rec.getString("category");
                if (c != null) {
                    cats.add(c);
                }
            }
            if (cats.isEmpty()) {
                sb.append("（数据集是空的 —— 先跑题并打分，或确认 root 是否正确。）\n");
                sb.append("root = ").append(root()).append('\n');
            } else {
                sb.append("可用的 category：").append(String.join(", ", cats)).append('\n');
                sb.append("也可以先用 LIST_DATASET_CATEGORIES 看分类目录。\n");
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
        int show = Math.min(limit, hit.size());
        sb.append("共 ").append(hit.size()).append(" 条匹配，显示前 ").append(show).append(" 条：\n\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < show; i++) {
            JSONObject rec = hit.get(i);
            sb.append("### [task ").append(rec.getInteger("task_id"))
              .append("] ").append(rec.getString("category"))
              .append("  verdict=").append(verdictLabel(rec))
              .append("  scorer=").append(rec.getString("scorer"))
              .append("  rounds=").append(rec.getInteger("round_count"))
              .append('\n');
            sb.append("题目：").append(oneLine(rec.getString("prompt"))).append('\n');
            String comment = commentOf(rec);
            if (comment != null && !comment.isBlank()) {
                sb.append("人工评语：").append(oneLine(comment)).append('\n');
            }
            String answer = rec.getString("reply_markdown");
            if (answer != null && !answer.isBlank()) {
                sb.append("AI 当时的回答：").append(abbrev(answer)).append('\n');
            }
            sb.append('\n');
        }
        if (hit.size() > show) {
            sb.append("（还有 ").append(hit.size() - show)
              .append(" 条未显示；调大 limit 或用 verdict 缩小范围。）\n");
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
    /* ==================== 小工具 ==================== */
    private static String verdictLabel(JSONObject rec) {
        JSONObject v = rec.getJSONObject("verdict");
        if (v == null) {
            return "unknown";
        }
        String label = v.getString("label");
        return label == null ? "unknown" : label.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
    private static String commentOf(JSONObject rec) {
        JSONObject v = rec.getJSONObject("verdict");
        return v == null ? null : v.getString("comment");
    }
    private static String modelOf(JSONObject rec) {
        JSONObject env = rec.getJSONObject("env");
        return env == null ? null : env.getString("model");
    }
    /** 把多行文本压成一行（记录里的 prompt/comment 可能含换行）。 */
    private static String oneLine(String s) {
        if (s == null) {
            return "";
        }
        return s.replaceAll("\\s+", " ").strip();
    }
    private static String abbrev(String s) {
        String flat = oneLine(s);
        return flat.length() <= ANSWER_MAX ? flat : flat.substring(0, ANSWER_MAX) + "…";
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/DatasetQuery.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/DeleteCameraBookmarkOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * DELETE_CAMERA_BOOKMARK：删除一个机位。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code name} 或 {@code index}（二选一，name 优先）。
 *
 * <p>删除后，<b>其后所有机位的下标会前移一位</b>——连续操作多个机位时，
 * 建议一次性用名字定位，或每删一个都重新 {@code LIST_CAMERA_BOOKMARKS}。
 */
public class DeleteCameraBookmarkOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    private JSONObject data;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "DELETE_CAMERA_BOOKMARK";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) {
        this.data = data == null ? new JSONObject() : data;
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException {
        int index = CameraBookmarkResolver.resolve(data, name());
        try {
            return FxThreads.call(() -> {
                var ui = HCloudbyte.ui.interfaces.UIInterface.getInstance();
                String removed = ui.getCameraRecords().get(index).getName();
                ui.removeCameraRecord(index);
                return "Success\n已删除机位 [" + index + "] " + removed
                        + "\n剩余 " + ui.getCameraRecords().size() + " 个机位";
            });
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IRException("DELETE_CAMERA_BOOKMARK_FAILED",
                    ListCameraBookmarksOperation.uiMessage(e));
        }
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/DeleteCameraBookmarkOperation.java========================================

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/FxThreads.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import javafx.application.Platform;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
/**
 * 把对 UI 机位悬浮窗的调用**切回 JavaFX 线程**并等待完成。
 *
 * <h3>为什么需要它</h3>
 *
 * <p>agent 的 {@code IOperation.execute} 跑在 {@code agent-worker} 线程上，
 * 而 {@link HCloudbyte.ui.viewport.CameraBookmarksView} 是 JavaFX 控件：
 * 它内部的 {@code records} 是非线程安全集合，且控件操作必须在 FX 线程做。
 * 从 worker 线程直接调用会有**竞态与 IllegalStateException** 风险。
 *
 * <h3>行为</h3>
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>已在 FX 线程 → 直接执行，不做线程切换；</li>
 *   <li>否则 → {@code Platform.runLater} 投递，并用 {@link CountDownLatch} 等它跑完，
 *       保证"AI 改完，UI 立刻一致"；</li>
 *   <li>被调代码抛的异常原样在调用线程重新抛出（含 {@code RuntimeException}）。</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class FxThreads {
    private FxThreads() {}
    /** 在 FX 线程上执行 {@code action} 并等待结果。 */
    public static <T> T call(FxCallable<T> action) throws Exception {
        if (Platform.isFxApplicationThread()) {
            return action.call();
        }
        if (!Platform.isFxApplicationThread()) {
            CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
            AtomicReference<T> result = new AtomicReference<>();
            AtomicReference<Throwable> error = new AtomicReference<>();
            Platform.runLater(() -> {
                try {
                    result.set(action.call());
                } catch (Throwable t) {
                    error.set(t);
                } finally {
                    latch.countDown();
                }
            });
            latch.await();
            Throwable t = error.get();
            if (t != null) {
                if (t instanceof Exception e) throw e;
                throw new RuntimeException(t);
            }
            return result.get();
        }
        // 理论上不可达
        return action.call();
    }
    /** 在 FX 线程上执行 {@code action}，不关心返回值。 */
    public static void run(FxRunnable action) throws Exception {
        call(() -> {
            action.run();
            return null;
        });
    }
    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface FxCallable<T> {
        T call() throws Exception;
    }
    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface FxRunnable {
        void run() throws Exception;
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/FxThreads.java========================================

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/GetDatasetRecordsOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * GET_DATASET_RECORDS：取数据集里某个类别的记录。数据集查询的**第二级**。
 *
 * <pre>
 * {"type":"GET_DATASET_RECORDS","id":1,"no_result":false,
 *  "data":{"category":"camera_bookmark","limit":5}}
 * </pre>
 *
 * <table>
 *   <caption>参数</caption>
 *   <tr><td>{@code category}</td><td>必填。类别名，取自 {@link ListDatasetCategoriesOperation}
 *       的分类目录；传 {@code all} 表示不限类别</td></tr>
 *   <tr><td>{@code model}</td><td>可选。按模型标识过滤，{@code deepseek} / {@code qwen}</td></tr>
 *   <tr><td>{@code verdict}</td><td>可选。按人工结论过滤：
 *       {@code correct} / {@code incorrect} / {@code skip} / {@code error} / {@code timeout}</td></tr>
 *   <tr><td>{@code limit}</td><td>可选。最多返回几条，默认 5，上限 50</td></tr>
 * </table>
 *
 * <p>返回的每条包含：题目、人工结论、人工评语、以及 AI 当时的回答（截断）。
 * **不含** {@code check}（机器判定的标准答案）—— 避免让模型"看到答案"而污染评测。
 */
public class GetDatasetRecordsOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    /** limit 上限，防止一次拉回整个数据集把上下文撑爆。 */
    private static final int LIMIT_MAX = 50;
    private static final int LIMIT_DEFAULT = 5;
    private String category;
    private String model;
    private String verdict;
    private int limit = LIMIT_DEFAULT;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "GET_DATASET_RECORDS";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        category = OperationParams.getRequiredString(data, "category", name());
        model = OperationParams.getOptionalString(data, "model", null);
        verdict = OperationParams.getOptionalString(data, "verdict", null);
        int raw = OperationParams.getOptionalInt(data, "limit", LIMIT_DEFAULT, name());
        limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(LIMIT_MAX, raw));
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException {
        return DatasetQuery.records(category, model, verdict, limit);
    }
}

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/GoCameraBookmarkOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * GO_CAMERA_BOOKMARK：跳转到指定机位（等价于 UI 上左键点击机位行）。
 *
 * <p>参数：{@code name} 或 {@code index}（二选一，name 优先）。
 *
 * <p><b>注意</b>：底层 {@code setPosition} / {@code setView} 会触发**约 1 秒的平滑过渡动画**，
 * 所以返回的 {@code pos/view} 是动画**开始时**的值，不是终值。跳转后不要立即
 * {@code GET_CAMERA_POS} 验证——拿到的是中间帧。
 */
public class GoCameraBookmarkOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    private JSONObject data;
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "GO_CAMERA_BOOKMARK";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException {
        // 参数校验推迟到执行时：寻址需要先拿到机位列表（在 run 中读取）。
        this.data = data == null ? new JSONObject() : data;
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException {
        int index = CameraBookmarkResolver.resolve(data, name());
        try {
            return FxThreads.call(() -> {
                var ui = HCloudbyte.ui.interfaces.UIInterface.getInstance();
                var record = ui.getCameraRecords().get(index);   // 取副本，供回显
                ui.applyCameraRecord(index);
                return "Success\n已开始切换到机位 [" + index + "] " + record.getName()
                        + "（过渡约 1 秒）"
                        + "\npos=" + OperationParams.formatVector4(record.getPosition());
            });
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IRException("GO_CAMERA_BOOKMARK_FAILED",
                    ListCameraBookmarksOperation.uiMessage(e));
        }
    }
}

//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/GuardedOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * 操作实现的公共基类：把"参数错误 / 执行错误"统一变成**该条操作的错误正文**。
 *
 * <h3>为什么这样做</h3>
 *
 * v2 文档 §2.3 / §2.4 要求：**单条操作失败只影响它自己，其余操作继续执行**，
 * 返回形如
 *
 * <pre>
 * # CREATE_MODEL(id=5)
 * Error: Model "Cube A" already exists
 * </pre>
 *
 * 而 {@code CommandExecutor} 是在收到 {@link IRException} 时**整批中止**并返回一个
 * Error Markdown（那是给 §2.3 的"格式错误"用的）。两者的差别在于：
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>格式错误（JSON 不合法、缺 type/id）→ 应该整批中止，由 executor 处理；</li>
 *   <li>单条参数非法 / 对象不存在 → 应该只让这一条返回 Error 正文。</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * 由于 {@code load()} 抛出的 {@link IRException} 会一路冒到 {@code IRParser}，
 * 造成整批中止，这里把"参数解析"与"执行"都**推迟到 {@code execute()} 里**，
 * 并在内部捕获，改写成错误正文返回。这样无需改动 {@code IRParser} / {@code CommandExecutor}
 * 就能满足文档语义。
 *
 * <h3>子类约定</h3>
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@link #parse(JSONObject)} —— 解析并校验参数，非法就抛 {@link IRException}；</li>
 *   <li>{@link #run(RendererInterface)} —— 真正执行，返回结果主体（不含 {@code # TYPE(id=n)} 头）。</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public abstract class GuardedOperation implements IOperation {
    /** 参数解析失败的异常，延迟到 execute 阶段转成错误正文 */
    private IRException loadError;
    /**
     * 解析并校验参数。
     *
     * @param data 操作参数，永不为 null（缺失时是空对象）
     * @throws IRException 参数缺失 / 非法时抛出
     */
    protected abstract void parse(JSONObject data) throws IRException;
    /**
     * 执行操作。
     *
     * @return 结果主体，例如 {@code "Success\nNow Pos=(-5, 0, 0, 0)"}
     */
    protected abstract String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException;
    @Override
    public final void load(JSONObject data) {
        try {
            parse(data == null ? new JSONObject() : data);
        } catch (IRException e) {
            this.loadError = e;
        }
    }
    @Override
    public final String execute(RendererInterface renderer) {
        if (loadError != null) {
            return OperationParams.errorBody(loadError);
        }
        try {
            return run(renderer);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            // 渲染侧用 IllegalArgumentException / NoSuchElementException / IndexOutOfBoundsException
            // 表达"参数不合法""模型不存在""下标越界"等业务错误，消息本身就是给 AI 看的，
            // 直接透传（文档 §2.3：错误文本直接采用渲染实现抛出的消息）。
            return OperationParams.errorBody(e);
        } catch (IRException e) {
            return OperationParams.errorBody(e);
        }
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/GuardedOperation.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/IOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * 所有 IR 操作的统一接口。
 * 每个具体操作实现这个接口
 */
public interface IOperation {
    /** 操作名称，必须和 JSON 里的 op 字段一致，如 “move” */
    String name();
    /** 接受 JSON 参数并绑定到当前操作对象 */
    void load(JSONObject args) throws IRException;
    /**
     * 执行操作，返回结果主体（不含 # TYPE(id=X) 头）。
     * 例如 "Success\nNow Pos=(-5, 0, 0, 0)"。
     */
    String execute(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException;
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/IOperation.java========================================
//========================================<src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/ListCameraBookmarksOperation.java>========================================
package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
import java.util.List;
/**
 * LIST_CAMERA_BOOKMARKS：列出 UI 中所有摄像机机位。无参数据。
 *
 * <p>返回格式：
 * <pre>
 * 共 2 个机位：
 * [0] 俯视   pos=(0, 10, 0, 0)
 * [1] 机位2  pos=(3, 0, -4, 1)
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>返回的 {@code [n]} 就是其它机位操作可用的 {@code index}。
 */
public class ListCameraBookmarksOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "LIST_CAMERA_BOOKMARKS";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) {
        // 无参数操作
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException {
        List<HCloudbyte.ui.viewport.CameraRecord> records;
        try {
            records = FxThreads.call(() ->
                    HCloudbyte.ui.interfaces.UIInterface.getInstance().getCameraRecords());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IRException("UI_UNAVAILABLE", uiMessage(e));
        }
        if (records.isEmpty()) {
            return "当前没有任何机位。";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("共 ").append(records.size()).append(" 个机位：");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            HCloudbyte.ui.viewport.CameraRecord r = records.get(i);
            sb.append("\n[").append(i).append("] ").append(r.getName())
              .append("  pos=").append(OperationParams.formatVector4(r.getPosition()));
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
    /** 把 UI 侧异常（含未初始化 / 非 FX 环境）转成给 AI 看的简短原因。 */
    static String uiMessage(Exception e) {
        String msg = e.getMessage();
        return "机位功能不可用：" + (msg == null || msg.isBlank() ? e.getClass().getSimpleName() : msg);
    }
}
//========================================END-src/main/java/weilantianhai/agent/ir/operations/ListCameraBookmarksOperation.java========================================

package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
import java.util.List;
/**
 * LIST_MODEL：列出场景中所有**根路径**（文档 §4.1.1）。无参数。
 *
 * <pre>
 * # LIST_MODEL(id=6)
 * 0. "Tower"
 * 1. "Gallery"
 * </pre>
 *
 * <p>要列出某个模型下面的部件，用 {@code GET_MODEL_INFO}。
 */
public class ListModelOperation extends GuardedOperation {
    @Override
    public String name() {
        return "LIST_MODEL";
    }
    @Override
    protected void parse(JSONObject data) {
        // 无参数操作
    }
    @Override
    protected String run(RendererInterface renderer) throws IRException {
        List<String> roots = renderer.getModel().listModel();
        if (roots.isEmpty()) {
            return "No models in scene";
        }
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < roots.size(); i++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                sb.append('\n');
            }
            sb.append(i).append(". \"").append(roots.get(i)).append('"');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

package weilantianhai.agent.ir.operations;
import com.alibaba.fastjson2.JSONObject;
import mai_onsyn.renderer.interfaces.RendererInterface;
import weilantianhai.agent.ir.IRException;
/**
 * MERGE_ALL_SUB_MODELS：把 {@code src} 命中的节点**连同它整棵子树**烘焙后合并成一个新模型
 * （文档 §4.1.8）。
